title: AHQ Furniture Archive
description: Concept-art catalogue of standalone medieval-fantasy furniture and dungeon props for Advanced HeroQuest.

baseImagePrompts.dungeon-furniture-v1: Create a single freestanding medieval-fantasy dungeon furniture prop in a cohesive Advanced HeroQuest-inspired art direction. Late-medieval European materials, dark weathered oak, subdued hand-forged iron, restrained tarnished brass, plausible construction, slightly exaggerated readable silhouettes, high-quality stylised hand-painted game-asset concept. Present exactly one object, centered and completely visible, in a clear three-quarter view with an orthographic-like camera, soft neutral studio lighting and a plain neutral or transparent background. Preserve consistent texture scale, proportions, shadow softness, lighting direction and visual style across this furniture collection. No room, no floor tiles, no characters, no labels, no text, no watermarks, no unrelated props.
baseImagePrompts.ritual-furniture-v1: Create a single standalone ceremonial dungeon furnishing in the same cohesive Advanced HeroQuest-inspired, stylised hand-painted 3D game-asset visual language as the main furniture collection. Use worn black stone, aged bronze, limited engraved detailing and credible heavy construction, with clear silhouettes and low visual noise. Exactly one centered object, fully visible, orthographic-like three-quarter view, soft neutral studio lighting and a plain neutral or transparent background. Keep consistent scale, light, texture detail and presentation across the arcane set. No room, floor tiles, characters, writing, watermarks or extra props.
